utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: Once again, good morning. Please be seated for the purpose of a Status Conference as foreseen in our Rules of Procedure and Evidence. The first and main topic is today to ask Dr. Stakic in person, what about his health? Do you have any problems at this point in time; and in addition, do you have any complaints related to the situation in the United Nations Detention Unit?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. Currently, I have no problems which would deserve mention.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: Thank you very much. You may be seated again. Any other issues to be addressed in a Status Conference? This is apparently not the case. Then let's express the hope that this was the last Status Conference during the trial phase of this case because within the next 120 days, at least we hope that we can hand down the judgement. But as mentioned previously, we can't promise anything when we can hand down the judgement. It's extremely difficult, but on the other hand we are aware of the right of Dr. Stakic to know what will be the outcome of the first instance in this case, and we will do whatever we can to be as expeditious as possible. I can't see any other contribution. And therefore, I hereby declare this Status Conference closed. And I heard that for technical reasons, it's not necessary to have an additional break.
